statusSemantics.not_required: The case has no MCP Provider telemetry requirement and proceeds without Provider input.
statusSemantics.not_ready: Required Provider observations or exact relations are absent; return NR, never score zero.
statusSemantics.degraded: The required task path exists while supporting progress, resource or reconciliation evidence is incomplete.
statusSemantics.ready: Required typed facts, exact relations and terminal observations are complete and conflict-free.
statusSemantics.conflict: Identity/hash, terminal, revision or relation evidence conflicts; fail closed for Provider input.
